result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback by limiting the termination payment to three months’ fees. However, it goes beyond making that amount the sole liquidated amount by making it HDI’s “sole and exclusive remedy,” which could waive unrelated remedies or accrued claims arising from the termination. It also states only a maximum and does not specify how the actual Termination Payment is determined, leaving subsections (b) and (c) to refer to an amount that has no operative calculation. The cap should instead define the payable amount and clarify that it is the sole liquidated or early-termination amount, without broadly eliminating other remedies.
